metadata.title: What Is IQ? Intelligence, Cognitive Tests and Scores
metadata.description: Learn how cognitive tests use raw scores, age norms, standard scores and percentiles, with a worked example and advice on choosing an assessment.

faq_items.question: Is IQ the same as intelligence?
faq_items.answer: Intelligence is the construct being investigated; IQ is a score from a particular assessment and reference system. Coverage, methods, norms and intended uses constrain its interpretation.

faq_items.question: Can matrix reasoning measure all intelligence?
faq_items.answer: It contributes visual relationship and rule-inference information. Other domains require other observations; the coverage and validity of any composite must be established for the specific instrument.

faq_items.question: Is 80% correct the 80th percentile?
faq_items.answer: No. Percentage correct refers to questions, while a percentile refers to a reference distribution or sample. The fictional example separately produces 80% correct, a transformed score of 115 and a model percentile near 84.1.

faq_items.question: Why can the same raw score produce different standard scores?
faq_items.answer: Forms, scoring and reference groups may differ. In the invented example, changing the reference mean changes the transformed score; those teaching values are not actual conversion tables.

faq_items.question: How precise is an IQ score?
faq_items.answer: Precision needs instrument-specific measurement-error evidence. The hypothetical 109–121 interval in the article illustrates a calculation under stated assumptions and must not be applied to an actual report.

faq_items.question: Are nonverbal tests culture-free?
faq_items.answer: Reduced language demands do not remove all cultural, educational, visual or familiarity influences. Fairness and adaptation need evidence for the instrument, groups and proposed uses.

faq_items.question: Can scores from different versions, languages or websites be converted?
faq_items.answer: Only where relevant comparability or linking evidence supports the conversion. Shared names, visual formats or a 100-based scale are insufficient.

faq_items.question: Are all online IQ tests invalid?
faq_items.answer: No. Delivery medium alone does not settle validity. Evaluate coverage, administration, population, norms, reliability and evidence for the intended interpretation.

faq_items.question: Does a score reveal genetic potential?
faq_items.answer: A single task score cannot separate individual genetic and environmental causes, calculate a personal genetic percentage or establish a fixed developmental ceiling.

title: What Is IQ? Intelligence, Cognitive Tests and Scores
excerpt: Understand cognitive abilities, raw scores, age norms, standard scores, percentiles and measurement uncertainty through a worked fictional example. Learn how to compare tools and choose formal assessment.
